input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale:
The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us. The licence grant in Section 2(a) is expressly non-exclusive and affirmatively confirms that we are "not obligated to utilize the License" and remain free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services (subject only to not infringing TrueLink's IP and to our confidentiality obligations) — this meets the preferred position and is language that benefits us. The only exclusivity-flavoured references run in our favour or are neutral: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink a nonexclusive licence to Credit Data, and Section 12's "solely and exclusively" wording is a forum-selection provision, not a dealing restriction. Section 3(i) requires that "Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface," but that is a narrow, self-triggered operational term applying only to transactions we voluntarily route through TrueLink's Interface; combined with Section 2(a) it leaves our procurement freedom intact and is not a requirements or sole-source covenant. Noted for awareness only, not flagged as a deviation.</parationale>
